subject: ForestWendigo
review_stage: Blender clips awaiting owner review before Unity
root_motion: none; Sim drives horizontal locomotion and leap displacement

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Idle
clips.beats: Subtle asymmetrical breathing, slight shoulder and antler-leaf overlap; grounded claws and feet.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Walk
clips.beats: Alternating planted digitigrade feet; counter-swing heavy arms; stable head/antlers; seamless frame 0/12.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Claw
clips.beats: Right shoulder coils and forearm lifts; one 140-degree, 2.7m ground-level claw sweep powered by torso/hips; planted stance; visible recovery.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Leap
clips.beats: Deep crouch; 9-frame airborne arc via visual pelvis height only; claws and digitigrade feet absorb landing; no horizontal root motion.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Hit
clips.beats: Brief readable recoil, no full-body collapse, blends back to current gameplay state.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Death
clips.beats: Forward weight loss, both claws brace, knees buckle, head lowers between arms; final pose remains supported on paws, no side roll or rebound.
